book.name: APOCALIPSIS
book.title: YIN̈ TZET AKꞌLAX YOHTAN̈ELO NAJ SAN JUAN YU COMAM JESUCRISTO

content: Chejbanile tet macta ayxaco yul iskꞌab Comam Jesucristo ay yul con̈ob Sardis

Yalnipaxo Comam: —Hac tiꞌ chu hatzꞌibn̈ento tet inchejaban chitan̈en macta ayxaco yul inkꞌaban ay yul con̈ob Sardis: “Comam ayco hujeb Yespíritu Comam Dios yin̈, yeb ikꞌbilcan̈ hujeb txꞌumel yu, haꞌ chalni hacaꞌ tiꞌ: Hanintiꞌan caw wohtajan tzet chewatxꞌe. Caw itzitzex yalbanil, yajaꞌ wal yul insatan camomex.
Tinan̈ xin, iwelo hewayan̈ cat heyocpaxo hewatxꞌen huntekꞌan tzet etza lan̈an istan̈iloj. Yuto chiwilan ta haꞌ tzet chewatxꞌe mach cꞌulo sata Comam Dios.

Naweti huntekꞌan cuybanile chabil heyu, lahweco heyijeni. Nawe heba, bejwecano hetxꞌojal yuto ta mach helano cheyute heba, chinapni lemnahan quexwilaꞌan yet tona nahul ayex, hacaꞌ chu yapni hunu naj elkꞌom yin̈ hunu mac tona nahul aya.
Yajaꞌ ay haywan̈ mac texol bey Sardis tuꞌ mach yetato isba, hacaꞌ hunu mac mach istzꞌiln̈eto xil iskꞌap, yuxin huntekꞌan mac tuꞌ yet ay yecꞌ wintajan, sajhopon̈e xil iskꞌap.
Haꞌ mac chikꞌoji, chialaxico xil iskꞌap caw sajhopon̈e yeb xin mach chinhocan̈an isbi yul hum yet kꞌinale; cat walnihan sata Inmaman yeb sata ebnaj ángel ta wetan yehi.
¡Maquex cheyabe huneꞌ tiꞌ akꞌwe heyanma hetxumni tzet chal Comam Espíritu tetej mac ayxaco yul inkꞌaban!” ẍi Comam.
Chejbanile tet macta ayxaco yul iskꞌab Comam Jesucristo ay bey Filadelfia

Yalnipaxo Comam: —Hac tiꞌ chu hatzꞌibn̈ento tet inchejaban chitan̈en macta ayxaco yul inkꞌaban ay yul con̈ob Filadelfia: “Comam machi nino istxꞌojal yin̈, yeb isyelaln̈eticꞌa chala, Comam ikꞌn̈e islawe naj rey David.
Comam hayet chishajni pulta machi hunu mac chu ispebani, hayet chispeban pulta, mach mac chu ishajni, chihalni hacaꞌ tiꞌ:

Hanintiꞌan wohtajan tzettaj chewatxꞌe. Ay huneꞌ pulta hajan teyet wuhan, machi hunu mac chu ispebani. Waxan̈ca machi heyip yajaꞌ caw yijem cheyute heba yin̈ intzotiꞌan. Machi xin chextxꞌixwilo win̈an.
Haꞌ huntekꞌan ebnaj chiyijen yin̈ tzet chal naj matzwalil, ebnaj chisbalico isba Israelal chinchejtojan ebnaj tecꞌatan̈ cat yay jahno ebnaj tesataj, cat yohtan̈enilo ebnaj ta xahan ayex wuhan.
Caw heyije inchejbanilan, nimanpaxo hecꞌul heyakꞌni techaho ilwebal, yu huneꞌ tuꞌ yuxin chexincolan yul iskꞌab huneꞌ isyaꞌtajil chihul sat yiban̈kꞌinal yun̈e yilwelax anma ay sat txꞌo txꞌotxꞌ tiꞌ.
Toxa chinhullemnahan, machojab chebej hewatxꞌen tzet chi-ticꞌa-hewatxꞌe, haxinwal machi hunu mac chiinilo ispaj selel chiakꞌlax teyet.

Haꞌ mac chikꞌoji, chiwacojan hacaꞌ yoyal yatut Inmaman, machi xin bakꞌin chiilaxiloj; chintzꞌibn̈enicojan isbi Inmaman yin̈ yeb isbi iscon̈ob Inmaman, huneꞌ acꞌ Jerusalén chitit yul satcan̈ bay ay inDiosalan, cat intzꞌibn̈enicojan inbihan acꞌ yin̈.
¡Mac chiaben huntekꞌan tiꞌ yakꞌab yanma istxumnilo tzet chal Comam Espíritu tet macta ayxaco yul inkꞌaban!” ẍi Comam.
Chejbanile tet macta ayxaco yul iskꞌab Comam Jesucristo ay yul con̈ob Laodicea

Yalnipaxo Comam: —Hac tiꞌ chu hatzꞌibn̈ento tet inchejaban chitan̈en macta ayxaco yul inkꞌaban bey con̈ob Laodicea: “Comam istꞌin̈anil chala, Comam testigo caw yijem yeb chalni isyelal, Comam watxꞌen̈e sunil tzettaj ye tuꞌ yeb Comam Dios, haꞌ chalni hacaꞌ tiꞌ:
Wohtajan tzet chewatxꞌe, wohtajan ta lahanex hacaꞌ hunu tzet chiucꞌlaxi mach chewoj, mach xin cajopaxoj, ayxicꞌa chew hex maca caj hex.
Yajaꞌ yu namanex, mach chewojex mach cajohexpaxoj, yuxin chexinpuchꞌiltijan yul intiꞌan.
Hex tiꞌ cheyala ta caw kꞌalomex, caw cꞌul heyin̈bal yeb caw sunil ay yul hekꞌab heyalni. Mach xin heyohtajoj tato caw cꞌanchꞌanex yeb caw yaꞌta heyehi. Caw mebaꞌ hex, mach chu heyilni, tꞌilanexpaxoj.

Wal xin chiwalan teyet lokꞌwe heoro wetan, chꞌen caw cꞌul watxꞌebilxalo xol kꞌa kꞌaꞌ. Hac tuꞌ xin chexoc kꞌalomal yin̈ caw isyelal, cat xin helokꞌni xil hekꞌap caw sajhopon̈e wetan, cat heyanico teyin̈ yun̈e mach chiel hetxꞌixobal yuto tꞌilanex. Chelokꞌnipaxo yan̈al isbakꞌ hesat wetan yun̈e chu heyilni.
Hanintiꞌan chincachan yeb chiwakꞌan isyaꞌtajil yiban̈ mac xahan ay wuhan. Wal xin aweco heyanma yin̈ Comam, nawe heba, bejwecano istxꞌojal.
Hanintiꞌan lin̈an inicojan sat pulta cat wawictojan, haꞌ mac chiaben yul innukꞌan cat ishajni yatut wetan, chinoctojan iscꞌatan̈ cat inwaꞌan yebi.
Haꞌ mac chikꞌoji isyijeni chiwakꞌan huneꞌ yehobal bay tzꞌon̈aninan, hacaꞌ yu inkꞌojihan, woc tzꞌon̈nojan iscꞌatan̈ Inmaman bay ay istzꞌon̈obal.
¡Maquex cheyabe huneꞌ tiꞌ, akꞌwe heyanma hetxumniloj tzet chal Comam Espíritu tetej macta ayxaco yul inkꞌaban!” ẍi Comam.

footnotes.text: Comam ikꞌn̈e islawe naj rey David, haꞌ chalilo tuꞌ ta ay yip Comam yanico anma yul iskꞌab Comam Dios.
